title: When Tone and Words Disagree: Towards Robust Speech Emotion Recognition under Acoustic-Semantic Conflict

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (accuracy and F1 scores) on the custom CASE benchmark, a dataset featuring audio samples where the vocal tone (acoustic emotion) intentionally contradicts the literal meaning of the words (semantic emotion), to measure the models' over-reliance on textual semantics over acoustic cues.
